You are evaluating a software engineering task for repository fastapi/fastapi.

Problem Statement:
✨ Show a clear error on attempt to include router into itself

Previously discussed in https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi/discussions/11424 with the PR at https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi/pull/11425

Since I made modifications in the fork of the repo, the PR was automatically closed. This PR serves to add the circular reference check again. Discussed again in https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi/discussions/14251

steps.message:
FILES: fastapi/routing.py:1372-1373
ROOT CAUSE: The `APIRouter.include_router` method does not check if the router being included is the same instance as the current router, which can lead to infinite recursion or circular references.
CHANGE: Add a check at the beginning of `APIRouter.include_router` to raise a `FastAPIError` if `router is self`. The error message should clearly state that a router cannot be included into itself.
TEST: Create a new test case in `tests/test_include_router.py` (or a similar existing test file) that attempts to call `router.include_router(router)` and asserts that a `FastAPIError` is raised.
